_comment: Lao profit tax (CIT) rates, as dated rows — same convention as lao_tax_templates.json.
A statutory rate change is a NEW ROW, never an edit, so that a period before the
change is still assessed at the rate that was in force during it.
Source: Law on Income Tax No. 88/NA, gazetted 19 June 2026, in force 1 July 2026.
It cut the standard rate from 24% to 20% and replaced the previous activity-based
treatment of microenterprises with a uniform 5% on NET PROFIT.
NOT MODELLED, deliberately: the special rates for listed companies (10%), tobacco
and alcohol (22%), mining concessions (35%), casinos (30%) and MNC group members
(15%). Each needs a qualification test this app cannot make on its own. A company
on one of those regimes must not rely on the estimate this data drives.
ALSO NOT MODELLED: the lump-sum (turnover-based) regime. It is available only to
businesses that do NOT maintain Lao accounting books — which a business running
this software does. See docs/BERP-LAO-TAXRIS-001.md and the roadmap note.
